artifacts.label: absent
artifacts.why: There is no Android device in this environment and there cannot be one: /dev/kvm is absent, so the x86_64 system image runs under QEMU's own instruction emulation. That was measured rather than assumed — adbd answered after 113 minutes and the framework never came up behind it, so there was no package service to install an APK into. There is no GTK either, so no desktop build can stand in for a second screen, and nothing here was faked from the PWA. docs/PHONES.md records all three routes tried.
artifacts.judged_because: Absent in both captures for the same standing reason in WHY_MISSING.json - no /dev/kvm on this machine - so nothing about it moved.
